title: The prior authorization market map, 2026
summary: Every company trying to fix prior authorization, placed by where its product starts. 132 vendors, 8 segments, 21 new entrants, and a founding-year chart that shows where the money went.
body_markdown:
We spend our days inside payer portals, so we keep a list of everyone who claims to fix prior authorization. This week we turned that list into an[interactive map](https://asteroid.ai/market-maps/prior-auth) .


## What is on it


132 companies in eight segments, placed by where the product starts:


- Provider-side automation: submission, status, appeals and documentation for practices and health systems. It is the biggest segment and the only one still growing.
- Payer-side UM: intake, criteria and decisioning for health plans.
- Delegated UM: the benefit managers that run prior auth on a plan’s behalf.
- Pharmacy ePA: electronic PA for drugs, hubs and specialty access.
- Voice AI: agents that sit on hold with the payer.
- Clearinghouses and RCM, where prior auth is one module among many.
- FHIR infrastructure: the rails for CMS-0057 electronic prior auth.
- EHR-embedded: prior auth inside the chart.


Hover any logo for a one-line description, founding year, HQ and funding. Filter by segment, search, or flip on the new-entrant toggle. Every view has a share link and a PNG export.


## What the data says


The founding rate tripled. Three companies a year from 2008 to 2020 became eleven a year from 2021 to 2024, with fifteen in 2023 alone.


The growth is one segment. Provider-side automation is 28 of the 44 companies founded from 2022 to 2025, and every company founded in 2026.


Payers stopped building. The newest payer-side and delegated UM companies were founded in 2023, and the incumbents there are a decade old.


Rebrands are common. Edifecs is now Cotiviti, Thoughtful AI is SmarterDx, Mercalis is Valeris, eBlu is CareTria and Ruma Care is Janeen. We followed every redirect, and each tile carries the current name with the old one in brackets.


## How we built it


Every description was rewritten from the company’s current site in October 2026. Founding years come from the companies, Y Combinator, Crunchbase and PitchBook. Eleven companies that pivoted away from prior auth were removed.


If you are on the map and we got something wrong, or you are not on it and should be, use the “Add your company” button on the page. It prefills a note tosupport@asteroid.ai .


[Open the prior auth market map](https://asteroid.ai/market-maps/prior-auth)
